"
broker_config.py
=================

Classifies every ticker in the universe to a real execution broker
(Hapi, Vantage, Binance) and defines the corresponding cost model.

WHY THIS EXISTS:
  The previous model (a flat COST_BPS per asset_group in
  Portfolio_Balancer.py) charged bps only on rebalance days (turnover).
  That is correct for spread-only brokers (Hapi, Binance), but it badly
  UNDERESTIMATES the real cost at Vantage (CFD), where the dominant cost
  is the swap/financing charged EVERY NIGHT the position stays open, not
  only when it turns over.

  This module splits cost into two components:
    1. cost_bps_turnover  → entry/exit cost (spread), charged on the
                            rebalance day over Σ|Δw|.
    2. swap_annual_rate   → holding cost (financing), charged EVERY DAY
                            over the position's current weight, prorated
                            daily.

BROKER STACK:
  - Hapi:    real stocks/ETFs, funded via USDT. No swap (real position).
  - Vantage: CFD for forex, commodities, and any equity Hapi doesn't cover
             (under the INCLUDE_NON_HAPI_AS_CFD flag). 825 stock CFDs +
             57 ETF CFDs available — reasonable fallback coverage.
  - Binance: real crypto spot. No swap.

DISCARDED — swap-free accounts (Vantage / VT Markets / Pepperstone):
  Evaluated and discarded for this pipeline. Pepperstone publishes its
  official fee schedule: the swap-free account charges no daily swap, but
  charges an Administration Fee" of $100 USD PER LOT every 5 days the
position stays open (source: Pepperstone Costs & Charges
For a typical 63-day holding (GROWTH_BETA/DIVERSIFIERS) that is ~12.6
swap (~$75-150 per lot over the same period). Swap-free accounts are
Vantage and VT Markets likely have an analogous admin-fee structure
(unconfirmed — same industry pattern); not worth pursuing unless the
pipeline moves to much more frequent rebalancing.
The Vantage swap_annual rates are still third-party ESTIMATES
official Vantage data. We do have an anchor from a direct competitor
- Forex majors/minors: varies by pair and direction (long/short are
(credit). This validates that our generic 2% for FOREX is not far
off for majors; exotics are another story.
- Crypto CFD (reference only — we use Binance spot): long 22.5%/yr
short 7.5%/yr. Far more expensive than spot — confirms the decision
single annual % — varies per commodity and contract month.
To replace the estimate with real VANTAGE data:
3. Note Swap Long / Swap Short (asymmetric — do not average).

"

from dataclasses import dataclass


# =============================================================================
# UNIVERSE COVERED BY HAPI
# =============================================================================
# Hapi offers >9000 NYSE/NASDAQ stocks/ETFs. In practice nearly all of
# GROWTH_BETA and DEFENSIVE_QUALITY qualifies. This list holds KNOWN
# EXCLUSIONS (odd ADRs, very small or foreign ETFs) — cheaper to maintain
# than a 200+ ticker whitelist.
#
# Confirmed fallback: if a ticker lands here and INCLUDE_NON_HAPI_AS_CFD=True
# is set, it routes to Vantage as an equity CFD.
HAPI_EXCLUSIONS = {
    'FANUY',   # Fanuc, Japanese OTC ADR — CONFIRMED absent from Hapi (2026-07)
    # Verified in the actual Hapi app (2026-07): BABA, JD, PDD, BIDU, NIO,
    # SNSR, TRFK, UFO, EBIZ, MILN, XSMO, AGNG, PRNT, AIRR, BIZD, WTV ARE
    # available — they do not belong here. The initial suspicion (Chinese
    # ADRs and boutique ETFs as likely gaps) proved mostly wrong; Hapi's
    # catalog is broader than assumed.
}

# Tickers that by definition are NEVER on Hapi (not a real stock/ETF)
NON_EQUITY_SUFFIXES = ('-USD', '=X', '=F')


# =============================================================================
# DIAGNOSTIC: isolate the swap effect (temporary, for cause comparison)
# =============================================================================
# When True, Vantage swap is zeroed but turnover/spread stays active — lets
# you run validation.py twice (True/False) and compare the SAME walk-forward
# window with and without swap, to confirm whether the daily drag actually
# flips the sign of a specific window instead of assuming it.
# Set back to False once the comparison is done.
DIAGNOSTIC_DISABLE_SWAP = False

# =============================================================================
# SWAP RATES — VANTAGE (placeholders, see module docstring)
# =============================================================================
# Annual rates per category, applied to the position's weight (%), prorated
# daily (/365). Source: third-party estimates, anchored against official
# Pepperstone data (direct competitor, same CFD structure) where possible.
VANTAGE_SWAP_ANNUAL_DEFAULT = {
    'EQUITY_CFD':    0.06,   # stocks/ETFs via CFD (Hapi-excluded or forced)
    'FOREX':         0.02,   # majors/minors; anchored to the Pepperstone
                             # AUDCAD long ≈1.75%/yr example — consistent
    'COMMODITIES':   0.06,   # metals/energy CFD; Pepperstone uses a
                             # contango/backwardation formula, not a fixed %
                             # — this remains a rough approximation
}

# Per-ticker overrides once real MT4/MT5 data from Vantage is available.
# Format: {'EURUSD=X': 0.018, 'GC=F': 0.045, ...}
VANTAGE_SWAP_OVERRIDES = {
    # fill with real Specification data from MT4/MT5 (Vantage)
}

# Entry/exit spread/commission at Vantage (bps over turnover) — kept from the
# previous COST_BPS model; this part IS reasonably well calibrated (spreads
# are public and stable).
VANTAGE_TURNOVER_BPS = {
    'FOREX':       1.5,
    'COMMODITIES': 8.0,
    'EQUITY_CFD':  5.0,   # stock CFD: spread similar to the share, no broker commission
}

# --- Hapi: turnover only (clearing fee), no swap (real position) ---
# $0.10/whole share, $0.15/fraction → approximated to bps over the average
# position notional (assuming a typical ticket ~1-2% of capital).
# This is an approximation; Hapi's real cost is *fixed per trade*, not
# proportional to size, so it overestimates cost for large accounts and
# underestimates it for small ones.
HAPI_CLEARING_FEE_USD = 0.125       # average of whole (0.10) and fraction (0.15)
HAPI_TURNOVER_BPS_APPROX = 3.0      # bps-equivalent fallback, same order as before

# --- Binance: unchanged from the previous model ---
BINANCE_TURNOVER_BPS = 15.0


# =============================================================================
# CLASSIFICATION ticker -> broker
# =============================================================================

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CostModel:
    broker: str
    turnover_bps: float     # charged over |Δw| on the rebalance day
    swap_annual: float      # charged daily over the current weight (0 = no swap)


def _is_non_equity(ticker: str) -> bool:
    return ticker.endswith(NON_EQUITY_SUFFIXES)
